$schema-note: Adapter inputs for one corpus build. `corpus build --inputs <path>` reads this file. Every `inputPath` and `streetIndex` is relative to $MAILWOMAN_DATA_ROOT, or to $MAILWOMAN_CACHE_ROOT when the entry states `"root": "cache"`, resolved at launch.
$draft-note: A draft for the next build, written 2026-11-17 and not yet built. The rebuilt and new sources replace or join their v0.8.19-overlay files in an overlay on that corpus.
$overlay-note: `usgov-nad` is rebuilt because its adapter now labels a place column that writes the record's own county as `subregion` (`1 1st Street, Polk County, OR 97347`). Over release 24 that relabels 243,004 of the 90,566,949 rows with a state, a ZIP Code and a place value. The adapter's code digest changes, so v0.8.19's NAD run can't be resumed. It reads the v0.8.18 street index, as v0.8.19-rebuild did, so the relabel is the run's only change. A v0.8.19 index doesn't exist yet. Every other v0.8.19-overlay source is carried unchanged, except the four PO-box sources of `$po-box-note`.
$snapshot-note: `usgov-nppes` reads the November 2026 NPPES dissemination (npidata_pfile_20050523-20261102.csv, sha256 2c78861a…f722c, 11,776,341,517 bytes, MANIFEST.json beside it), downloaded 2026-11-18, in place of May 2026's file, which v0.8.19 read. The adapter is rebuilt for the PO-box relabel either way, so the newer file adds no build. A BAN export of 2026-11-17 sits at snapshots/ban/2026-11-17/ for the next BAN rebuild; this draft keeps v0.8.19's BAN run.
$po-box-note: `usgov-nppes`, `state-tx-notaries`, `state-ia-contractors` and `state-ny-notaries` are rebuilt because each now labels a whole-line PO box `po_box` where v0.8.19 labeled it `street` (lane AC, 2026-11-17). The codex matcher reads `POB 1088`, NPPES calls `splitUSStreetLine` as the other three did, and NY takes a box written on either address line rather than matching the two lines joined. Over the inputs below the fixed adapters relabel 17 of 16,912 IA rows, 27 of 511,304 TX rows, 395 of 32,097 NY rows and 9,666 of 9,197,061 NPPES rows (scratchpad/2026/11/17/lane-ac/po-box-relabel-count.ts). Each adapter's code digest changes, so none of the four v0.8.19 runs can be resumed. Their inputs and street index are v0.8.19-rebuild's. Two recipe fixes of the same lane reach training only when their recipe outputs are re-rendered, which this draft doesn't do: `po-box-cedex` splits a PMB row's street into `street_prefix`, `street` and `street_suffix`, and the FR leg of `postal-unit-guideline` labels a named complex (`RESIDENCE …`, `LOTISSEMENT …`) `venue`. The training files `corpus-v0.8.0/invented-po-box-cedex.parquet` and `corpus-v0.8.1/invented-postal-unit-guideline-v0.8.1.parquet` keep the earlier labels.
$recipe-outputs-note: This file names adapters only: `readBuildInputs` reads `adapters` and nothing else, and a recipe output reaches a corpus through `mailwoman corpus recipe` and the overlay, as every recipe output in v0.8.19 did. The recipe outputs this build adds are therefore recorded here as the invocations to run, each writing an `.invocation.json` beside its output under `corpus/recipe-outputs/`. `us-county` writes three new sources. `invented-house-venue` replaces both v0.8.19 files, `corpus-v0.8.0/invented-house-venue.parquet` and `corpus-v0.8.1/invented-house-venue-intl-v27.parquet`, which predate the record-id repair of #2894 and record neither the tuples nor the limit they were built from.
